on 30 March,
2026  IN THE HIGH COURT FOR THE STATE OF TELANGANA  AT HYDERABAD  THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE N.V.SHRAVAN KUMAR

entities.text: HIGH COURT FOR THE STATE OF TELANGANA  AT HYDERABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
WRIT PETITION No.9045 of 2026  DATE: 30.03.2026 Between:
Bommena Anantha Rao  ...Petitioner  AND The State of Telangana,
Rep. by its Principal Secretary,
Revenue (Land Acquisition) Department,
Dr.B.R.Ambedkar Telangana Secretariat,
Tank bund Road, Hyderabad and 3 others  ...Respondents ORDER:
Heard G.Jhansi, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.1 to 3 and learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and Commercial Area Development appearing for respondent No.4.
2.

This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking the following relief:
"A) Issue an Appropriate Writ, Order or Direction in the nature of Writ of Mandamus under Article 226 of the Constitution declaring the action of the Respondent No.3 in refusing to receive the Petitioners Application/Representation U/Sec.64 of Act 30 of 2013 vide dated 14- 03-2026 for enhancement of compensation sent by Speed Post Acknowledgement Due (SPAD) and returning the Postal Cover with an endorsement "Refused" vide dated 17-03-2026

is illegal,
arbitrary and violation of the principles of natural justice and highhandedness and also contrary to the provisions of Act 30 of 2013.

B) Issue an Appropriate Writ, Order or Direction in the nature of Writ of Mandamus under Article 226 of the Constitution declaring the action of the Respondent No. 3 in not referring the Land Bommena Anantha Rao vs The State Of Telangana on 30 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117853103/
1 Acquisition Award No.08/2015-16, File No.F/224/2012, dated: 19-10-2015, pertaining to the Petitioner property bearing H.No.1-15 & 1-15/1 (as per Award H.No.1-15 & 1-15/A) to an extent of 1438 Sq.yds. of area situated at Kodurupaka Village, Boinpalli Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District,
U/Sec.64 of Act 30 of 2013 to the Competent Authority i.e., Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, at Hyderabad (LARRA) for enhancement of compensation pursuant to the Application/Representation dated 14-03-2026 as illegal, arbitrary, unfair, discriminatory and in violation of Articles 14, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and contrary to the Provisions of Act, 30 of 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority, at Hyderabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
C) And Consequently direct the Respondent No. 3 herein to refer the Land Acquisition Award No.08/2015-16, File No.F/224/2012, dated: 19-10-2015, pertaining to the Petitioner property bearing H.No.1-15 & 1-15/1 (as per Award H.No.1-15 & 1-15/A) to an extent of 1438 Sq.yds. of area situated at Kodurupaka Village, Boinpalli Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District, U/Sec.64 of Act 30 of 2013 to the Competent Authority i.e., Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority,
a t H y d e r a b a d ( L A R R A ) f o r e n h a n c e m e n t o f c o m p e n s a t i o n p u r s u a n t t o t h e Application/Representation dated: 14- 03-2026 by receiving the same and also as per the Docket Order and Decree dated 13-02-2026 in LAOP No.25 of 2018, and pass..."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner has made an application/representation under Section 64 of Act 30 of 2013 seeking enhancement of compensation.
The said representation was sent by speed post however, the same has been returned with the postal cover with an endorsement "Refused" on 17.03.2026.
Questioning the same, the present writ petition is filed.
4. When the matter was taken up on 26.03.2026, learned Assistant Government Pleader sought time to get instructions.
Today, when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader reports no instructions.

In that view of the matter, in similar facts and circumstances, this Court in W.P.No.35596 of 2025 dated 25.11.2025 disposed of the writ petition directing the concerned respondent to consider the representations of the petitioners therein.

6. Since the petitioner's representation is filed along with the writ material papers, learned Assistant Government Pleader is directed to forward the representation dated 14.03.2026 made by the petitioner to respondent No.3.

The respondent No.3 is directed to take appropriate steps and refer the matter under Section 64 of the Act, 30 of 2013 to the competent authority within a period of four (04) weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
Thereafter, the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority (LARRA) shall pass appropriate orders on the representation of the petitioner as expeditiously as possible.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 7. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any are pending, shall stand closed.
